source.title: Express Self-Checkout is Delivering a Faster, More Enjoyable Target Experience
source.type: Target 官方顾客体验案例
source.context: 说明顾客需求、服务调整和结账体验结果
paragraphs: Guests told us they wanted a choice in how they completed their store purchase, whether it’s at the self-checkout or with a team member. So, in March 2024, we rolled out our Express Self-Checkout lanes with limits of 10 items or fewer at most of our nearly 2,000 stores nationwide. The big idea? We wanted to give guests an even easier and more convenient option for those quick trips, so they can get their shopping done faster.

With these changes, we’ve created a faster checkout experience overall, improving total transaction times by nearly 8%. And according to the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for checkout — a measure of customer experience — we’ve improved our already high score for wait times by 5 points.

Beyond a faster transaction, guests tell us they’re enjoying their time with our team members more, too. Whether they’re offering a helping hand, providing a moment of connection or sharing more ways to save with your Target Circle membership, our team members simply make the shopping experience better. In fact, the NPS for interaction at checkout is up 3 points.
translations: 顾客希望能选择自助结账或由员工协助。2024 年 3 月，Target 在近 2,000 家门店推出 10 件或以下商品的快速自助结账通道。
这些调整使总交易时间缩短了近 8%。结账等待时间的顾客推荐值提高了 5 分。
顾客也表示更喜欢与员工互动。事实上，结账互动的顾客推荐值提高了 3 分。
fullTextParagraphs: Check it out: About one year since its debut, Express Self-Checkout is helping guests in our stores get on their way sooner, however they want to complete their Target run.

Guests told us they wanted a choice in how they completed their store purchase, whether it’s at the self-checkout or with a team member. So, in March 2024, we rolled out our Express Self-Checkout lanes with limits of 10 items or fewer at most of our nearly 2,000 stores nationwide. The big idea? We wanted to give guests an even easier and more convenient option for those quick trips, so they can get their shopping done faster.
Meanwhile, we opened more traditional lanes staffed by our best-in-retail team for when your cart is full, with more than 25,600 nationwide.

With these changes, we’ve created a faster checkout experience overall, improving total transaction times by nearly 8%. And according to the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for checkout — a measure of customer experience — we’ve improved our already high score for wait times by 5 points.

Our team is always laser-focused on delivering a better experience for guests, and that’s exactly what they get with Express Self-Checkout. Whether guests are grabbing stuff for dinner or running in to pick up a post-soccer tournament treat, we know their time is valuable, and they often need to be on their way quickly. By giving them a few options for checking out — on their own, with a team member or even using Drive Up — we’re making their experience fast, easy and on their terms.
Adrienne Costanzo Executive Vice President and Chief Stores Officer, Target

Beyond a faster transaction, guests tell us they’re enjoying their time with our team members more, too. Whether they’re offering a helping hand, providing a moment of connection or sharing more ways to save with your Target Circle membership, our team members simply make the shopping experience better. In fact, the NPS for interaction at checkout is up 3 points.

With results like these, we’ll continue to enhance and evolve the checkout experience — whether you choose to take Express Self-Checkout or visit our team member-assisted lanes. Add in our same-day fulfillment services like Drive Up, Order Pick Up and our same-day delivery, and we’re delivering the convenience, joy and value of the Target run, however, whenever and wherever you want to shop.
We’re here to help all families discover the joy of everyday life through digital discovery and exceptional in-store experiences.

scenario.title: 汇报门店排队方案的效果
english: A grocery chain added a short express lane for shoppers with fewer than eight items and kept staffed lanes for full carts.
Average transaction time improved by 6%, while customer ratings for staff interaction rose by two points.
Write a short update that separates the speed result from the service rating.
chinese: 一家超市为少量购物的顾客增加快速通道，同时保留员工服务的普通通道。
平均交易时间改善了 6%，顾客对员工互动的评分提高了 2 分。
写一条简短更新，把速度结果与服务评分分别说清楚。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请给门店运营团队写三句话：说明顾客需要什么选择、Target 做了哪些调整，以及结账时间和顾客推荐值如何变化。
firstAttempt.sample: Guests wanted a choice between a quick self-checkout and help from a team member. Target added 10-item Express Self-Checkout lanes while keeping staffed lanes for larger carts. Total transaction times improved by nearly 8%, and the checkout wait-time NPS rose by five points.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说顾客要解决的事，再讲服务安排，最后分别报告效率和体验指标。
